fields.why: The Table gives symptom prevalence among adults with disabilities for each of 6 age groups, 5 race/ethnicity groups, 4 income levels and 3 education levels.

These are the SPDs with 3 or more levels and an outcome per group. Disability itself is a pair (with vs without) and gives no entry. Employment status (5 levels, an SES component under the brief) is also shown side by side but was not entered; that changes no field value.
No test is run across these levels. The chi-square, McNemar and aPR tests all contrast with vs without disability (aPRs within each subgroup: rule 6), so the mechanical flag is a false alarm.
